title: Write operator retention and GC guide
description:
Write docs/operator/retention.md: how to configure pinning rules, how GC works, how to interpret the GC audit log, how to recover from accidental unpinning, how to estimate storage usage. Artifact: docs/operator/retention.md.

Acceptance criteria: a reader of this doc can configure a pinning policy for a small multi-group server; GC audit log format documented with example output
